Package dayplanner

Class Activity

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.Activity
Direct Known Subclasses:
HomeActivity, OtherActivity, SchoolActivity
public abstract class Activity extends Object

  • Constructor Details

    • Activity

      public Activity(String title, Time start, Time end, String comment)
      Creates an activity, an argument exception if any value is invalid
      Parameters:
      title - the title, cannot be empty
      start - the starting time
      end - the ending time, must be after the start
      comment - an optional comment, null is treated as empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the title is empty or the times are invalid
